objective: Complete the revised-contract Dev-5 V3 replay after declaring the omitted external workspace fixture and changing only the network used by the infrastructure-blocked bootstrap.

runner_contract.source: Create a local no-hardlinks detached checkout from the retained Git object database at the exact inherited revision; never fetch or read dirty worktree files.
runner_contract.cleanliness_gate: Require exact HEAD and tree identity plus an empty git status before adding declared external fixtures or running bootstrap.
runner_contract.container_git_gate: Add only /data/project to Git safe.directory for the temporary bind mount.
runner_contract.mount: Mount the temporary checkout at /data/project and EnvSolve policy code read-only.
runner_contract.external_fixture: Create only preregistered safe single-component directories after the clean-checkout gate, fail on repository-path collision, and retain them only in temporary case state. This models the frozen verifier workspace and is not a repository repair rule.
runner_contract.bootstrap: Source the exact inherited frozen bootstrap in one persistent shell without creating benchmark result artifacts.
runner_contract.network_transition: Allow network only during bootstrap; disconnect every Docker network before metadata collection and probes.
runner_contract.project_distribution: Use only frozen PEP 610 or legacy egg-link plus uniquely matched project-owned metadata provenance.
runner_contract.probe_execution: Use isolated package and entry-point imports plus non-executing console PATH resolution from an empty directory with a 30-second timeout.
runner_contract.aggregation: Any project distribution failure fails V3; any collection error makes V3 unknown unless another distribution already failed; only complete successful collection may pass.
runner_contract.temporary_storage: Use the host platform temporary directory unless an explicit bind-mount-safe root is supplied.
runner_contract.cleanup: Always remove the container and temporary checkout.

execution_gate.reason: Round 10 Poetry bootstrap was blocked by two files.pythonhosted.org ReadTimeout failures; the user requested a WiFi change before retrying network failures.

allowed_intervention.workspace_fixture: Declare the previously implicit build_output directory through the generic collision-checked runner input.
allowed_intervention.infrastructure_retry: Use a user-confirmed different network for one otherwise identical replay.
allowed_intervention.forbidden: No bootstrap, source, target, metadata collector, smoke policy, aggregation policy, timeout, image, or official verifier change.

expected_causal_checks.inflect: Bootstrap may recover only because the declared external build_output fixture is present; a collision must fail before bootstrap.
expected_causal_checks.poetry: Bootstrap may recover only as an infrastructure retry after network change; V3 still runs with every Docker network disconnected.
expected_causal_checks.round10_passes: Gpkit, Reticulum, and pytest-xdist must retain their revised-contract V3 decisions or be reported as regressions.
expected_causal_checks.multi_distribution: A partial metadata collection can never aggregate to V3 pass.
expected_causal_checks.official_outcomes: No official verifier runs and no official score changes.
